title: Projects in software egineering
body:
Misspelling of [[Projects in software engineering]] ("egineering" is missing its *n*), kept
as its own file. The project-management material lives in the correctly spelled note:
estimates, the scope/schedule/resources trade, and why adding people to a late project makes
it later.

If the two are ever collapsed, this is the one to delete; nothing else in the vault links
here.
